intent: Context Telemetry Ingestion & Validation. Use Mockito doubles for TelemetryEventStore and AuditTrail and SimpleMeterRegistry. ingest(samples, correlationId) appends one TelemetryRecord with revision 1 per sample and emits the number appended. Status is VALIDATED when deviceId and metric are not blank, tDevice is present and value is finite; otherwise VALIDATION_FAILED (still appended, never dropped). Counters: telemetry.ingress.packets (tag outcome=accepted), telemetry.samples.validated (tags metric, status), timer telemetry.ingest.latency (tag outcome). Exactly one audit record per call: actor = deviceId of the first sample or 'system' when empty, action 'INGEST', outcome 'ACCEPTED', timestamp set, correlationId as passed. Use StepVerifier.

methods.signature: public IngestTelemetryUseCase(TelemetryEventStore store, AuditTrail auditTrail, MeterRegistry meterRegistry)
public Mono<Long> ingest(Flux<TelemetrySample> samples, String correlationId)
